name: gh
description: Run the GitHub CLI through the sandbox, gated to only the invocations the agent's exec_pattern_allow config grants (e.g. "gh pr create*" or "gh pr merge*"). Input: {"args": ["pr", "create", "--base", "main"]}. Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}. No matching pattern configured = gh is disabled; a command matching no pattern is refused.
llm_description: Run GitHub CLI (gh) commands, gated to patterns granted by exec_pattern_allow (e.g. "gh pr create*"). {"args":["pr","create","--base","main"]}. Returns {"ok","code","stdout","stderr"}; no matching pattern = refused.
